keys.title: Physical key bindings
keys.description:
The meaning of physical keys F4-F11 depends on the remote hardware version (HA100A: light/curtain/music/AC/custom 1-4; HA100B: rewind/play-pause/stop/fast-forward/custom 1-4).

Command semantics: Astrion remote = button name or IR code (empty = resolved from code library by button name); Broadlink = device/key; Harmony = activity/device name.
